    Normalized derivations #

    For path data on B, every derivation δ : B → Hom_k(M, X) differs by an inner derivation from one vanishing on all vertex idempotents (exists_normalized), and a normalized derivation vanishing on all arrows is zero (eq_zero_of_normalized).

    source
    theorem BrickAccessibility.MonomialData.exists_normalized {k : Type u_1} [Field k] {B : Type u_2} [Ring B] [Algebra k B] {M : Type u_3} [AddCommGroup M] [Module B M] [Module k M] [IsScalarTower k B M] {X : Type u_4} [AddCommGroup X] [Module B X] [Module k X] [IsScalarTower k B X] (D : MonomialData k B) (δ : B →ₗ[k] M →ₗ[k] X) (hδ : δ ∈ Ext1.cocycles k B M X) :
    ∃ (φ : M →ₗ[k] X), ∀ (v : D.Q.V), (δ - (Ext1.inner k B M X) φ) (D.e v) = 0

    Every derivation is cohomologous to one vanishing on the vertex idempotents.

    theorem BrickAccessibility.MonomialData.eq_zero_of_normalized {k : Type u_1} [Field k] {B : Type u_2} [Ring B] [Algebra k B] {M : Type u_3} [AddCommGroup M] [Module B M] [Module k M] {X : Type u_4} [AddCommGroup X] [Module B X] [Module k X] [IsScalarTower k B X] (D : MonomialData k B) (δ : B →ₗ[k] M →ₗ[k] X) (hδ : δ ∈ Ext1.cocycles k B M X) (he : ∀ (v : D.Q.V), δ (D.e v) = 0) (hα : ∀ (a : D.Q.A), δ (D.α a) = 0) :
    δ = 0

    A derivation vanishing on vertices and arrows is zero.
